about: What the intake agent must do with a trader's words. Every `procedureId` is checked against the published catalogue before the case runs, so a wrong expectation fails as bad gold rather than as a product bug.

cases.message: export 60 tonnes of tea from Tashkent to Moscow by train
cases.why: The original hand-checked procedure; if this moves, the corpus or the lookup moved.

cases.message: export 20 tonnes of tomatoes from Tashkent to Almaty by train
cases.why: A product named inside a category: the case is for tomatoes, published as fresh fruits and vegetables.

cases.message: export 20 tonnes of raisins from Tashkent to Almaty by train
cases.why: Raisins are only ever dried, so no question is needed.
Apricots are published both ways; intake must ask rather than pick.

cases.message: import 12 tonnes of yoghurt from Almaty to Tashkent by road
cases.why: A category unreachable before the corpus grew; also the regime question, since dairy by road is published as a full import and as a clearance.

cases.message: import 12 tonnes of yoghurt from Almaty to Tashkent by road
replies: Customs clearance only — the goods are already at the border
cases.why: The other answer to the same question must reach a clearance procedure, not the full import.

cases.message: export 5 tonnes of carpets from Tashkent to Moscow by train
cases.why: One published treatment only, so no regime question.

cases.message: import 2 tonnes of medicines from Istanbul to Tashkent by air
cases.why: Medicines reach pharmaceutical products; air imports are published as a full import and as a clearance.

cases.message: export 60 tonnes of cement from Tashkent to Almaty by train
cases.why: A dense bulk category: the load must size against the wagon's weight limit, not the 30 t default.

cases.message: export 5 tonnes of walnuts to Turkey by air
cases.why: "Turkey" is the country. Reading it as poultry was a real bug; walnuts themselves are not published.

cases.message: import 20 tonnes of apple juice from Almaty to Tashkent by train
cases.why: Juice before fruit: apple juice is 2009, not apples.

cases.message: arrange cargo transportation by train, 40 tonnes from Tashkent to Almaty
cases.why: Asking for carriage is not naming goods; it reaches the rail-logistics procedure.

cases.message: export 60 tonnes of urea fertilizer from Tashkent to Almaty by train
cases.why: Mineral fertilizers are their own category, distinct from the animal or vegetable ones.

cases.message: import 30 tonnes of tea from Tashkent to Moscow by train
cases.why: The route decides: Tashkent to Moscow is an export, whatever the trader typed.

cases.message: what is the weather like today
What documents are needed for export?
cases.why: A procedure question belongs to the FAQ, not to case intake.

cases.message: export 2 tonnes of saffron by air to Dubai
cases.why: Saffron is a spice; nothing published covers it, and the refusal must name the goods.
Not in the lexicon, but plainly a textile: the nearest published category is proposed with its reasoning, and waits for a yes.

cases.message: вывозим 20 тонн чая из Ташкента в Алматы поездом
cases.why: A message the rules cannot read is restated by the model, and the rules decide from the restatement.
